declaration.entry:
- name: agent-platform
  align: true
  choreReviewers:
    - teemow
  system: agent-platform
  componentType: service
  gen:
    flavours:
      - app
    language: generic
    # Renovate image-tag bumps in helm/*/values.yaml regenerate the chart README
    # and values.schema.json on the PR branch instead of failing pre-commit
    # (agent-platform#295, #301, #302, #320; devctl#2185).
    helmDocsRegen: true
    ci:
      generate: true
      overrideChartAppVersion: true
      # Publish the dev chart on branch builds (RFC semver-based-automatic-upgrades
      # dev channel); custom.yml mirrors it for agent-platform-connectivity.
      branchPublish: true
      # The kagent API v2 chart smoke runs the platform Harness (kagent's
      # controller, Agent Substrate, a gVisor worker) on the job's kind cluster
      # (giantswarm/agent-platform#343); the repo's .ats/kind-config.yaml shapes
      # the cluster. Initial size, to be confirmed by the smoke's measured runs.
      atsResourceClass: large
      # The meta chart's release push waits on the repo's verify-release-floors
      # job (custom.yml): every component floor and BOM pin must resolve to a
      # published chart, or the release is refused before the chart is pushed
      # (giantswarm/agent-platform#624).
      chartReleaseGateJob: verify-release-floors
